gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-001 recognizes the interior-node basis and homogeneous-versus-nonhomogeneous boundary mismatch for the trial problem, but does not independently identify the separate mismatch between the full dual-cell piecewise-constant test space and its interior-node span. Its generic instruction to modify the test space does not establish recognition of that specific defect.

ISSUE-002 concerns insufficient time-uniform regularity of the coefficient Phi in an H3 stability argument. Gold I002 instead concerns the advertised quantifier over v in H2, for which the displayed derivatives and L4 Laplacian terms are not defined or controlled. These are different missing hypotheses and failure operations.

Both entries concern an asserted H3 auxiliary estimate, but ISSUE-002 diagnoses missing coefficient regularity and time-uniform bounds. Gold I003 diagnoses the absence of higher-order boundary compatibility or trace conditions needed for the integrations by parts. ISSUE-002 does not recognize that boundary-condition defect.

ISSUE-007 identifies that the error equation produces the mass-lumped pairing rather than the ordinary L2 pairing, that the displayed mass-lumped quantity lacks the square root and therefore has the wrong scaling, and that the resulting energy identity is unsupported. Its repair directly supplies the correctly scaled norm and compatible energy argument.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The proof treats the mass-lumped quadratic pairing as an ordinary L2 norm squared while defining the associated norm without a square root, so the claimed linear norm equivalence and ordinary-L2 time-energy identity do not follow.

component_coverage.gold_component: The mass-lumped pairing is not the ordinary L2 norm squared and the defined quantity has quadratic rather than linear scaling, invalidating the energy derivative.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction explicitly identifies both the mass-pairing mismatch and the missing square root, and connects them to failure of the L2 energy estimate and its repair.

component_coverage.gold_component: The compatible repair must use a square-root FV mass norm and a valid mass-lumped energy identity before norm equivalence.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction specifies defining the square-root mass norm, establishing the needed positivity/symmetry or symmetric-part formulation, and redoing the estimate in that norm.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 exactly identifies that the auxiliary equations contain |grad Phi| squared while the consistency residual uses |Phi| squared, so the displayed error identity is not obtained by subtraction. It gives the same corrected residual and recognizes the consequent failure of the auxiliary estimates.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The reaction coefficient in the residual is copied incorrectly as |Phi|^2 instead of the common coefficient |grad Phi|^2 from the two auxiliary equations, invalidating the residual identity and all estimates derived from it.

component_coverage.gold_component: Subtracting the two stated auxiliary equations must preserve |grad Phi|^2, whereas the displayed residual uses |Phi|^2 and therefore is not the error equation.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction states the exact coefficient discrepancy and explains why the residual identity cannot result from subtracting the equations.

component_coverage.gold_component: The wrong residual invalidates the auxiliary error bounds and must be corrected throughout the subsequent estimates.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: The prediction connects the wrong residual to the Proposition pro2 bounds and prescribes replacing every occurrence of |Phi|^2 by |grad Phi|^2 with the required product estimates rechecked.

gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-008 correctly questions the unproved transfer from an auxiliary iteration to the nonlinear semidiscrete solution and the identification of iteration limits. It does not recognize the additional specific defect that the proof uses a piecewise-linear discrete iterate as a coefficient outside the prescribed coefficient space, nor the missing continuous-versus-discrete coefficient-difference residual. The broader claim that convergence is unproved is therefore incomplete for gold I006.
